item.title: Version 0.1.17
item.description:
RunBar 0.1.17 — accurate weekly goal suggestion after a fresh Strava connect.
Two related fixes when you onboard or reconnect a Strava account:
• The seed used to divide the total km by a hard-coded "4 weeks" — but the Strava API Agreement § 7.1 limits us to a rolling 7-day cache, so a fresh sync only fills ~1 week of activities. An 85 km/week runner was being quoted 19 km/week as their average. The divisor now adapts to the actual span of available data, clamped to 1–4 weeks. • The seed now ignores the in-progress ISO week. A Monday morning install with 0 km logged this week was dragging the average down; the current week is by definition partial and unrepresentative. Only fall back to it if there is no completed-week data at all.
Net effect: the suggested target is closer to your actual recent pace, even on a fresh BYO connection.
